integrity: All equations and boundary cases were reconstructed and tested by exhaustive enumeration through n=7; the infinity statements have symbolic proofs in RESULT.md. No independent verification or novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The strict stochastic order is proved for finite n>=2 and origin fugacity t>=1, not t<1. The ordinary random-mapping covariance and its asymptotic are separate corollaries under t=1. Earlier general cyclic-point and indegree enumeration results supply relevant marginal distributions; historical priority of the new all-parameter stochastic comparison is provisional pending independent review.
title: Strict stochastic suppression of cyclic cores by origin weighting in random mappings
